A Call to Build Something Better

We are planting a curated garden in a world increasingly overrun by weeds. This is the mission, who it is for, and how it endures.

Start wherever you're drawn. Each section opens with its heart — read deeper when you're ready. The rest will be waiting.

Why
We follow Christ · The reason it exists

We believe what we consume shapes who we become.

The world does not need more noise. It needs more light. SaintStream exists to be one of those places.
Read the full Why

We follow Christ.

He loves the individual. He loves the family. He loves the body of Christ — His Church.

SaintStream is built to strengthen all three.

Every day we are surrounded by messages competing for our attention, shaping our beliefs, influencing our values, and ultimately affecting who we become.

Therefore, we intentionally curate media that strengthens faith, family, agency, virtue, hope, truth, beauty, and light.

SaintStream exists because we believe there should be a place where individuals and families can confidently gather, discover, learn, create, and be uplifted without constantly navigating messages that undermine the things they hold sacred.

This is not about isolation from the world. It is about cultivation. Just as a gardener carefully chooses what to plant, what to nurture, and what to remove, we seek to cultivate an environment where goodness can flourish.

Who it's for

A home for Latter-day Saints — and believing Christians everywhere.

If you hold these values dear, there is a place for you here — whatever your gift: creating, teaching, building, giving, serving, or simply encouraging.
Find your place

SaintStream is a home for Latter-day Saints living the gospel beyond Sunday — and for Christian, believing people everywhere who hold these values dear. Every part of the experience is governed by truth: curated, reviewed, and family-safe by default, so you can trust what you find here.

Creators — musicians, filmmakers, authors, podcasters, artists, and storytellers who want their work to strengthen rather than diminish.
Families — seeking a trusted place to gather.
Teachers & leaders — mentors and organizations who want to strengthen their communities.
Students — preparing to become the next generation of creators, builders, and servants.
Listeners, viewers & readers — tired of searching through darkness to find something uplifting.
Donors & leaders — who want their resources to help build something that lasts.

Every gift has value. Every contribution matters.

What
What it is

More than a streaming service.

SaintStream is a community, a platform, and an ecosystem dedicated to helping light spread further.
What that means

It is where uplifting music, films, books, podcasts, educational content, communities, and creators come together.

Where creators find audiences.

Where audiences find trusted content.

Where students find mentors.

Where projects find support.

Where families find resources.

Where organizations find partners.

More than a streaming service, SaintStream is an effort to cultivate a culture where faith, family, truth, beauty, goodness, and hope can flourish. We are not simply distributing content — we are helping build a community devoted to strengthening one another.

Where
Where it lives

Wherever people seek light.

SaintStream is not confined to a screen. It exists wherever someone reaches for something that strengthens rather than weakens.
Everywhere light is needed

In homes and living rooms.

In classrooms and campuses.

In workshops and studios.

In cars and on commutes.

In communities and congregations.

In moments of celebration. In moments of grief. In times of certainty. In times of searching.

SaintStream exists wherever someone reaches for something that strengthens rather than weakens, uplifts rather than degrades, and inspires rather than distracts.

When
Why now

The need has never been greater.

We live in an age of unprecedented connection — yet increasing loneliness.
Why this moment
Unprecedented connection→increasing loneliness
Unlimited information→growing confusion
Endless entertainment→declining meaning

The tools available to creators today are more powerful than at any point in history. So is the influence of the messages competing for hearts and minds.

This generation has been given extraordinary opportunities to create, teach, build, and serve. SaintStream exists for this moment — and for the generations that follow.

$
How the mission is sustained

Not extraction. Cultivation.

SaintStream is not built around extracting value from people. It is built around creating value for people.
How resources flow

The mission is sustained through many forms of contribution working together.

Subscribers help provide the recurring foundation that keeps the platform alive and allows creators to be supported as their work is heard, watched, read, and shared.

Creators contribute the music, stories, films, books, teaching, testimony, and art that give SaintStream its purpose.

Donors help make possible what subscriptions alone cannot yet carry: new projects, student opportunities, creator grants, Kid Kingdom content, educational work, technology, outreach, and long-term stability.

Organizations and partners bring mentorship, credibility, community, and opportunities that help creators and families flourish.

SaintStream's financial model is designed to keep resources moving toward the mission: sustaining the platform, supporting creators, funding worthy projects, and expanding access to uplifting media. As SaintStream grows, its resources should be reinvested into the people and work that strengthen the believing community.

Not extraction. Cultivation.
Preserving the mission

Built to endure, not just to launch.

SaintStream was not created merely to solve a problem for today. It was created to serve future generations.
How it stays rooted

Political climates change.

Cultural trends change.

Technologies change.

Social expectations change.

But the need for truth, faith, family, beauty, goodness, and hope remains. SaintStream must remain rooted in its purpose regardless of changing fashions, pressures, ideologies, or trends.

Future leaders, contributors, donors, creators, and stewards should understand that they do not own the mission. They are entrusted with it for a season. Their responsibility is not to reinvent its purpose, but to preserve and strengthen it for those who come after.

SaintStream should adapt its methods without abandoning its mission. As long as people seek light, there will be a need for places that help them find it.

A Call to Action

A song can change a heart.

A story can change a family.

A testimony can change a life.

A teacher can change a generation.

A donor can help an idea become reality.

A community can help someone discover they are not alone.

SaintStream exists for all who are seeking more light, and for all who are willing to help provide it. If you create, teach, build, give, mentor, organize, listen, watch, read, share, or encourage, there is a place for you in this mission.

Together, we can help light reach places it might not reach alone.

We invite you to join us.
